arxiv-1405-2642.title: An Abductive Framework for Horn Knowledge Base Dynamics
arxiv-1405-2642.creator: Radhakrishnan Delhibabu
arxiv-1405-2642.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Radhakrishnan Delhibabu. The dynamics of belief and knowledge is one of the major components of any autonomous system that should be able to incorporate new pieces of information. We introduced the Horn knowledge base dynamics to deal with two important points: first, to handle belief states that need not be deductively closed; and the second point is the ability to declare certain parts of the belief as immutable. In this paper, we address another, radically new approach to this problem.

arxiv-2012-12491.title: Superconducting instabilities in a spinful Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model
arxiv-2012-12491.creator: Étienne Lantagne-Hurtubise, Vedangi Pathak, Sharmistha Sahoo, Marcel Franz
arxiv-2012-12491.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Étienne Lantagne-Hurtubise, Vedangi Pathak, Sharmistha Sahoo, Marcel Franz. We introduce a spinful variant of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model with an effective time reversal symmetry, which can be solved exactly in the limit of a large number N N of degrees of freedom. At low temperature, its phase diagram includes a compressible non-Fermi liquid and a strongly-correlated spin singlet superconductor that shows a tunable enhancement of the gap ratio predicted by BCS theory.

arxiv-2210-06560.title: First Steps of Planet Formation Around Very Low Mass Stars and Brown Dwarfs
arxiv-2210-06560.creator: Paola Pinilla
arxiv-2210-06560.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Paola Pinilla. Brown dwarfs and very low mass stars are a significant fraction of stars in our galaxy and they are interesting laboratories to investigate planet formation in extreme conditions of low temperature and densities. In addition, the dust radial drift of particles is expected to be a more difficult barrier to overcome during the first steps of planet formation in these disks.

arxiv-2301-07623.title: A Complete HCN Survey of the Perseus Molecular Cloud
arxiv-2301-07623.creator: T. M. Dame, Charles J. Lada
arxiv-2301-07623.description: Abstract We present a survey of the Perseus molecular cloud in the J = = 1 → \rightarrow 0 transition of HCN, a widely used tracer of dense molecular gas. The survey was conducted with the CfA 1.2 m telescope, which at 89 GHz has a beam width of 11’ and a spectral resolution of 0.85 km s -1 .

arxiv-2305-04055.title: Science and Technology Ontology: A Taxonomy of Emerging Topics
arxiv-2305-04055.creator: Mahender Kumar, Ruby Rani, Mirko Bottarelli, Gregory Epiphaniou, Carsten Maple
arxiv-2305-04055.description: Abstract Ontologies play a critical role in Semantic Web technologies by providing a structured and standardized way to represent knowledge and enabling machines to understand the meaning of data. Several taxonomies and ontologies have been generated, but individuals target one domain, and only some of those have been found expensive in time and manual effort.

arxiv-2312-14375.title: R-Pool and Settlement Markets for Recoverable ERC-20R Tokens
arxiv-2312-14375.creator: Kaili Wang, Qinchen Wang, Calvin Cai, Dan Boneh
arxiv-2312-14375.description: Abstract ERC-20R is a wrapper around ERC-20 that supports asset recovery within a limited time window after an asset is transferred. It is designed to reduce theft and losses on the blockchain by allowing a victim to recover their stolen or lost assets during the recovery window.

arxiv-2408-01010.title: Joint tail of randomly weighted sums under generalized quasi asymptotic independence
arxiv-2408-01010.creator: Dimitrios G. Konstantinides, Charalampos D. Passalidis
arxiv-2408-01010.description: Abstract . In this paper we revisited the classical problem of max-sum equivalence of randomly weighted sums in two dimensions. In opposite to the most papers in literature, we consider that there exists some interdependence between the primary random variables, which is achieved by a combination of a new dependence structure with some two-dimensional heavy-tailed classes of distributions.

arxiv-2410-02939.title: Inductive Generative Recommendation via Retrieval-based Speculation
arxiv-2410-02939.creator: Yijie Ding, Jiacheng Li, Julian McAuley, Yupeng Hou
arxiv-2410-02939.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yijie Ding, Jiacheng Li, Julian McAuley, Yupeng Hou. Generative recommendation (GR) is an emerging paradigm that tokenizes items into discrete tokens and learns to autoregressively generate the next tokens as predictions. While this token-generation paradigm is expected to surpass traditional transductive methods, potentially generating new items directly based on semantics, we empirically show that GR models predominantly generate items seen during training and struggle to recommend unseen items.

arxiv-2412-10303.title: Relativistic Viscous Hydrodynamics in the Density Frame: Numerical Tests and Comparisons
arxiv-2412-10303.creator: Jay Bhambure, Aleksas Mazeliauskas, Jean-François Paquet, Rajeev Singh, Mayank Singh, Derek Teaney, Fabian Zhou
arxiv-2412-10303.description: Abstract We conduct a numerical study of relativistic viscous fluid dynamics in the Density Frame for one-dimensional fluid flows. The Density Frame is a formulation of relativistic viscous hydrodynamics that is first-order in time, requires no auxiliary fields, and has no non-hydrodynamic modes.

pmc-10531609.title: Transcriptomic and Metabolomic Analyses Reveal the Key Genes Related to Shade Tolerance in Soybean
pmc-10531609.creator: Aohua Jiang, Jiaqi Liu, Weiran Gao, Ronghan Ma, Jijun Zhang, Xiaochun Zhang, Chengzhang Du, Zelin Yi, Xiaomei Fang, Jian Zhang
pmc-10531609.description: Soybean (Glycine max) is an important crop, rich in proteins, vegetable oils and several other phytochemicals, which is often affected by light during growth. However, the specific regulatory mechanisms of leaf development under shade conditions have yet to be understood.

pmc-10737018.title: GERIATRIC WORKFORCE ENHANCEMENT PROGRAMS AS AAA AGE-FRIENDLY INITIATIVES PARTNER
pmc-10737018.creator: Jennifer Severance, Linda Edelman, Barbara Gordon, Susanna Luk-Jones, Jacqueline Telonidis, Jennifer Morgan
pmc-10737018.description: The Health Resources and Services Administration funded 48 Geriatric Workforce Enhancement Programs (GWEPs) to partner with community-based organizations in addressing gaps in health care for older adults, promoting Age-Friendly ecosystems, and addressing social determinants of health. This paper discusses three GWEPs collaborative projects with Area Agencies on Aging (AAAs) that deliver community-based programs .

pmc-12412391.title: NALCN/Cch1 channelosome subunits originated in early eukaryotes
pmc-12412391.creator: Adriano Senatore, Tatiana D Mayorova, Luis A Yañez-Guerra, Wassim Elkhatib, Brian Bejoy, Philippe Lory, Arnaud Monteil
pmc-12412391.description: This work explores the evolutionary origins of the sodium leak channel NALCN and its ancillary subunits FAM155/Mid1, UNC79, and UNC80. We uncover ancient origins for these subunits in eukaryotes, and identify animals, fungi, and apusomonads as three distinct lineages possessing all four NALCN subunits.

pmc-12441319.title: Independent and repeated acquisition of Sodalis endosymbiotic bacteria across the diversification of feather lice
pmc-12441319.creator: Juliana Soto-Patiño, Kimberly K O Walden, Jorge Doña, Lorenzo Mario D'Alessio, Sarah E Bush, Dale H Clayton, Colin Dale, Kevin P Johnson
pmc-12441319.description: Many parasitic insects, including lice, form close relationships with endosymbiotic bacteria that are crucial for their survival. In this study, we used genomic sequencing to investigate the distribution and evolutionary history of the bacterial genus Sodalis across a broad range of feather louse species spanning 140 genera.

pmc-13096884.title: Prognostic value of the CT-based Suidan scoring system in advanced epithelial ovarian cancer
pmc-13096884.creator: Chao Deng, Dan Yan, Hai-Bo Qu, Yan Zeng, Li-Hua Deng, Feng-Lin Jia, Xi-Jian Chen, Gang Ning
pmc-13096884.description: PurposeThis study aimed to evaluate the prognostic utility of the Suidan CT-based scoring system in patients with advanced epithelial ovarian cancer (AEOC) undergoing either primary debulking surgery (PDS) or neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by interval debulking surgery (NACT-IDS). The score’s correlation with residual disease and survival outcomes was examined.

pmc-13288104.title: Dual function of ERH in primary miRNA biogenesis
pmc-13288104.creator: Simon Aschenwald, Aswini K Panda, Theresa Wurzer, Sonja Baumgärtner, Valerie S Ertl, Jakob Hatzer, Andreas Villunger, Sebastian Falk, Sebastian Herzog
pmc-13288104.description: MicroRNAs are small non-coding RNAs that mediate post-transcriptional silencing of most mammalian genes. They are generated in a multi-step process initiated by the Microprocessor, a protein complex composed of DROSHA and DGCR8. Recent studies have described the phenomenon of “cluster assistance,” in which a prototypic primary miRNA hairpin can license the Microprocessor-mediated processing of a clustered suboptimal hairpin in cis.

pmc-13520222.title: The association between paternal PTSD and child mental health: a systematic literature review
pmc-13520222.creator: Liquori L Etheridge, Sungseek Moon, Aynsley H Scheffert, Christina Chan-Park, Danny Clark
pmc-13520222.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fathers play a crucial role in their children’s psychosocial development, positively influencing emotional, cognitive, and social competencies. Paternal Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) can disrupt this dynamic, potentially compromising the psychological well-being and developmental outcomes of their offspring. This systematic review aims to investigate the relationship between paternal PTSD and the prevalence of psychopathology in children and adolescents, providing a comprehensive understanding of how trauma experienced by fathers may influence their children’s mental health.

pmc-13554892.title: When Coronary Thrombosis Outpaces Technical Success
pmc-13554892.creator: Rafael Alessandro Ferreira Gomes
pmc-13554892.description: Corresponding AuthorKey words: anticoagulation, antiplatelet, coronary artery bypass, hemostasis, postoperative, thrombosis Coronary revascularization is usually judged by what the operator can see: a well-constructed graft, a patent anastomosis, a fully expanded stent, absence of dissection, and restoration of TIMI flow grade 3. These technical end points are essential. However, they do not always guarantee durable clinical success.

pmc-13700381.title: Quantifying multidisciplinary collaboration in Huntington’s disease before and after service redesign: a social network analysis
pmc-13700381.creator: Yenni Lie, Susan Mathers, Ruth Hosken, Julie C Stout, Emily Mercieca, Yufei Xu, Henry Ma, Thanh G Phan
pmc-13700381.description: BackgroundEffective multidisciplinary collaboration underpins integrated care for people living with Huntington’s disease (HD). Traditional evaluations focus on patient outcomes or self-reported collaboration, which may not capture the underlying structure of team interactions. Social network analysis (SNA) provides an objective method to map collaboration structures and quantify changes associated with service redesign.
